decisions.rationale: Recorded post-import edit: make the folder-tree model semantic in the source HTML (a genuinely nested list, or explicit full paths) instead of encoding depth only in CSS custom properties, keeping the visual design unchanged. Regenerate the companion with the tool and check that the Markdown shows / > home > ana and what belongs under ana.

Still open by external cause: gnu.org is unreachable from this host. Keep the man7 receipts out of the final evidence and keep retrying. If gnu.org stays down, firstmate escalates the choice of official-source host to the captain rather than substituting one.
